#!/usr/bin/env python3

# Research DES weak keys as mentioned in the Wikipedia article
# https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Weak_key

import binascii

# According to Wikipedia, DES has 4 weak keys and 12 semi-weak keys

# Weak keys produce the same ciphertext as plaintext when used for encryption 
# This happens because the subkeys generated for all 16 rounds are identical

print("DES Weak Keys (in hexadecimal):")

# 1. The all-zeros key
weak_key1 = "0000000000000000"
print(f"1. All zeros key: {weak_key1}")

# 2. The all-ones key
weak_key2 = "FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"
print(f"2. All ones key: {weak_key2}")

# 3. First half all zeros, second half all ones
weak_key3 = "00000000FFFFFFFF"
print(f"3. First half zeros, second half ones: {weak_key3}")

# 4. First half all ones, second half all zeros
weak_key4 = "FFFFFFFF00000000"
print(f"4. First half ones, second half zeros: {weak_key4}")

print("\nTotal number of weak keys: 4")

# Semi-weak keys come in pairs (K1, K2) where encryption with K1 
# followed by encryption with K2 gives the identity function
# These are also referred to as dual keys

print("\nDES Semi-Weak Keys (in hexadecimal):")

semi_weak_pairs = [
    ("01FE01FE01FE01FE", "FE01FE01FE01FE01"),
    ("1FE01FE00EF10EF1", "E01FE01FF10EF10E"),
    ("01E001E001F101F1", "E001E001F101F101"),
    ("1FFE1FFE0EFE0EFE", "FE1FFE1FFE0EFE0E"),
    ("011F011F010E010E", "1F011F010E010E01"),
    ("E0FEE0FEF1FEF1FE", "FEE0FEE0FEF1FEF1")
]

for i, (key1, key2) in enumerate(semi_weak_pairs, 1):
    print(f"{i}. Pair: {key1} and {key2}")

print(f"\nTotal number of semi-weak keys: {len(semi_weak_pairs) * 2}")

# There are also 48 possibly weak keys (not listing them all)
print("\nTotal number of possibly weak keys: 48")

print("\nComplete list of all weak and semi-weak keys:")
all_keys = [weak_key1, weak_key2, weak_key3, weak_key4]
for key1, key2 in semi_weak_pairs:
    all_keys.append(key1)
    all_keys.append(key2)

for i, key in enumerate(all_keys, 1):
    print(f"{i}. {key}")

print(f"\nTotal weak and semi-weak keys: {len(all_keys)}")
